name: wingmanpm-product-designer
description: Product design judgment for coding agents building accessible, responsive digital products.

interface.shortDescription: Design better products with coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Read product context, compare polished local design directions, and build the chosen interface. Includes a visual comparison board, saved choices, scoped checks, responsive UI patterns, accessible data tables, transparent AI flows, and browser evidence. Uses small on-demand references, preserves product facts and local edits, and checks for skill updates through the owning distribution channel. Support: https://github.com/Qewler/wingmanpm-product-designer/issues
defaultPrompt: Explore two polished directions for this product flow
Review this interface and explain the highest-impact fixes
Polish this flow without changing its product behavior
